summary: Backend-only regression for new CyclePattern values. Verified /api/workplaces accepts SD_F_F_SN_F_F and SD_F_F_SD_F_F (both return 201 and echo pattern), PUT update to a legacy pattern (SD_F_SN_F_F) works and persists via GET, bogus pattern 'XYZ' returns 422, GET returns correct cycle_pattern for each row, and three legacy patterns (SD_F_SN_F_F, SD_SN_F_F, SD_F_SN_F) still create successfully. 8/8 tests pass against the public preview URL.
action_items: None for this change – all cycle_pattern behaviours pass. Optional: consider disabling pytest-xdist loadscope for tests that share module-level state, or refactor CREATED dict into a pytest fixture, to make future parallel runs deterministic (does not affect production).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:37 – CyclePattern Literal correctly extended to include the two new 6-day patterns; Pydantic validation propagates cleanly to POST/PUT and rejects unknowns with 422.
server.py:226 wp_defaults keeps default cycle_pattern='SD_F_SN_F_F' for pre-existing docs lacking the field – safe.
Minor (unrelated): server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'|'shutdown') – FastAPI recommends lifespan handlers, but not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Reused demo@escalafacil.com (login fallback). Test workplaces prefixed with TEST_ are auto-deleted in the module-scoped teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_cycle_patterns.py with `-o addopts=''` (or without pytest-xdist) because tests share a module-level CREATED dict for created workplace IDs; xdist loadscope splits classes across workers and breaks dependencies. Public URL: EXPO_BACKEND_URL. Auth via demo@escalafacil.com / demo123456 (register-then-login-on-400 pattern).
rca_of_issue: N/A – no product bug. Two initial test failures were caused by pytest-xdist splitting TestNewCyclePatterns and TestUpdateAndValidation onto different workers, so the module-scoped CREATED dict populated in one worker was empty in the other. Rerunning single-process yielded 8/8 pass.
